title: Swift Programming — Final Assessment Blueprint

topic_distribution.area: Language fundamentals, syntax, types and control flow
Collections, functions, optionals, errors and types
Foundation, persistence, networking, concurrency, packages and tests
SwiftUI, architecture, production engineering and specialist paths

outcomes: Write and reason about correct Swift code.
Choose safe data and error-handling models.
Explain value/reference semantics and concurrency isolation.
Design and verify a simple application or package.
Identify security, accessibility, platform and version constraints.
grading_policy: Knowledge-check questions can be machine-graded by the existing protected assessment mechanism. Code quality, projects, accessibility and platform-specific work require review unless a suitable isolated Swift runner and tests are configured.
remediation: For each missed area, revisit the linked lesson, complete its practice exercise, compile a minimal example locally, then retry according to the platform policy.
certificate_policy: No certificate should be issued unless the backend verifies a passing attempt and certificate issuance is implemented.
